scope: repair_ecc.py read whole in two nontruncated ranges1-229 and230-end; pinned blob verified. Syntax parse only, no repair execution or ECC backend installation.

findings.detail: Heuristic iterates range(len(buf)-max_marker_length), omitting the final legal start offset and all starts when buffer length equals marker length. Shorter field markers near EOF are also excluded by longest-marker bound.

skip_until is a buffer-relative offset but persists across read iterations. A valid marker found late in previous buffer can cause leading region of next buffer to be skipped. Source-level finding, no end-to-end reproduction.

Candidate marker list stores one local minimum per close neighborhood; equal-distance alternatives are dropped. Nearby matching payload may be rewritten as marker without whole-entry verification. The tool explicitly warns it may miss markers.

Index marker type and decoded position are used without explicit type1..2, monotonicity, overlap or file-length checks. A decoded offset beyond EOF can cause sparse extension on write. No such write executed.

Index decode call is not enclosed in per-record ECC exception handling. An uncorrectable record can abort rather than continue as diagnostic. Short trailing record is passed into codec without explicit length refusal.

Return is zero after heuristic pass regardless of lost indexes, remaining corrupt markers or reparsed ECC validity. Output is copied then modified directly without final structural verification transaction.
